changelog:
Initial release: Structured Lesson Learned (LL) Capture & Indexing tool

- Provides guided, structured capture, classification, and indexing of Lessons Learned (LL) for project/quality engineers.
- Outputs LL knowledge base templates and searchable indexes in both plain text (.txt) and Markdown (.md) formats.
- Emphasizes standardized fields, root cause association, and retrieval—distinct from generic case management or rewriting tools.
- Supports interactive collection of project background, categorization, root cause linkage, actions, and retrieval tags.
- Delivers easy-to-use index structures to help organizations avoid repeated mistakes and drive knowledge reuse.
- Clear role definition, boundaries, and built-in best practices; missing information clearly marked for later completion.
summary: 面向质量/项目工程师，对经验教训做结构化捕获、分类与检索沉淀，避免经验散失，输出 LL 沉淀模板与知识库索引（纯文字版 .txt + Markdown .md）。
